trainingPlan: Warm-up: 10-15 minutes of jogging, skipping, or cycling to increase blood flow and loosen up muscles.
Plyometrics: This type of training helps improve explosive power and speed. Here are some exercises the player can perform:
Jump squats: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, lower into a squat, and then jump as high as possible. Repeat for 3 sets of 10 reps.
Box jumps: Stand in front of a sturdy box or platform, and then jump up onto it, landing softly. Repeat for 3 sets of 10 reps.
Bounds: Starting in a lunge position, jump forward as far as possible, landing on the front foot. Repeat for 3 sets of 10 reps on each leg.
Sprints: This type of training will help improve the player's acceleration and overall speed. Here are some exercises the player can perform:
30-meter sprints: Sprint at maximum effort for 30 meters, rest for 30 seconds, and repeat for 6-8 sets.
Shuttle runs: Set up 2 cones 10 meters apart. Sprint from one cone to the other, touch the ground, and sprint back. Repeat for 6-8 sets.
Hill sprints: Find a steep hill and sprint up it as fast as possible. Walk down to recover and repeat for 6-8 sets.
Strength training: This type of training will help the player build overall strength and power, which will translate into improved speed on the court. Here are some exercises the player can perform:
Lunges: 3 sets of 8 reps on each leg
Cool-down: 5-10 minutes of light jogging or cycling, followed by stretching to help prevent muscle soreness and injury.
